name: 50393-fp8kvtriton-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, one GPU, one node.
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), rate = 6 req/s, bounded at 600 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion, seed static 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompts exactly 1024 tokens and outputs exactly 256 (min = max on both), drawn independently, so there is no shared prefix and prefix caching is off.
purpose: An 8B-parameter chat assistant handling steady long-prompt, short-answer requests at six per second on a single GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 50393-fp8kvtriton-8b-1gpu. The engine is the commit pinned in setupcard.md
# (`commit_id`); the interpreter that carries it is named in env.yaml.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

kv-cache-dtype: fp8

# Keep this value on ONE line as inline JSON. The config reader is a LINE reader and skips
# indented lines, so a block-style mapping is dropped whole and silently, at rc=0, and the engine
# then starts on auto-selected attention. Quoting the JSON is not an alternative -- that yields a
# string, which validation rejects.
attention-config: {"backend": "TRITON_ATTN"}

tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: uni

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
